system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: saas-vpc
    type: compute.v1.network
    properties:
      autoCreateSubnetworks: false
      routingConfig:
        routingMode: REGIONAL

  - name: saas-app-subnet
    type: compute.v1.subnetwork
    properties:
      description: Subnet for application services
      ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/24
      region: us-central1
      network: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
      privateIpGoogleAccess: true

  - name: saas-sql-psc-range
    type: compute.v1.globalAddress
    properties:
      purpose: VPC_PEERING
      addressType: INTERNAL
      prefixLength: 24
      network: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)

  - name: saas-servicenetworking-connection
    type: gcp-types/servicenetworking-v1:services.connections
    properties:
      parent: services/servicenetworking.googleapis.com
      network: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
      reservedPeeringRanges:
        - $(ref.saas-sql-psc-range.name)
      service: servicenetworking.googleapis.com

  - name: saas-sql-pg15
    type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:instances
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - saas-servicenetworking-connection
    properties:
      name: saas-sql-pg15
      databaseVersion: POSTGRES_15
      region: us-central1
      deletionProtectionEnabled: true
      settings:
        tier: db-custom-2-7680
        availabilityType: REGIONAL
        dataDiskSizeGb: 100
        dataDiskType: PD_SSD
        storageAutoResize: true
        activationPolicy: ALWAYS
        backupLocation: us
        backupConfiguration:
          enabled: true
          startTime: 03:00
          pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
          backupRetentionSettings:
            retainedBackups: 7
            retentionUnit: COUNT
        ipConfiguration:
          ipv4Enabled: false
          privateNetwork: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
        maintenanceWindow:
          day: 7
          hour: 3
          updateTrack: stable
        databaseFlags:
          - name: cloudsql.iam_authentication
            value: "on"
          - name: log_min_duration_statement
            value: "200"
          - name: log_connections
            value: "on"
          - name: log_disconnections
            value: "on"
          - name: log_statement
            value: "ddl"
        insightsConfig:
          queryInsightsEnabled: true
          queryStringLength: 1024
          recordApplicationTags: true
          recordClientAddress: true
        userLabels:
          env: prod
          app: saas-platform
          managed-by: deployment-manager

  - name: saas-db
    type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:databases
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - saas-sql-pg15
    properties:
      name: app
      instance: $(ref.saas-sql-pg15.name)

outputs:
  - name: instanceConnectionName
    value: $(ref.saas-sql-pg15.connectionName)
  - name: instanceSelfLink
    value: $(ref.saas-sql-pg15.selfLink)
  - name: privateIpAddress
    value: $(ref.saas-sql-pg15.ipAddresses[0].ipAddress)
  - name: vpcSelfLink
    value: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
  - name: serviceNetworkingConnection
    value: $(ref.saas-servicenetworking-connection.name)
